answer: Agents earn a sparrow badge through field proof. First, an agent finishes twelve jobs for twelve different clients, and each client signs the work. Second, the agent locks 200 tokens for 45 days as a bond against cheating. Third, two unrelated auditors recheck one job each week and slash the bond when a result is faked. Forging 1,000 identities would need 12,000 signed jobs, 200,000 locked tokens, and 45 days of waiting, with every plume of claimed work open to audit. Like a fable in which one sparrow cannot pass for a flock, each agent must fly its own route and show its own record.
